products.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic (MOLA topography, delta geoid), 20 m/pixel
products.instrument: Context Camera (CTX), stereo-derived DTM controlled to MOLA
products.citation: Fergason, R.L., et al., 2020, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation Flight Product Generation: Digital Terrain Model and Orthorectified Image Mosaic, 51st Lunar and Planetary Science Conference. Product page: https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_2020_terrain_relative_navigation_ctx_dtm_mosaic. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5066/P906QQT8
products.usage_terms: USGS/NASA product, public domain (U.S. Government work); credit USGS Astrogeology / NASA / JPL-Caltech / MSSS
products.coordinate_type: projected (Equirectangular, metres) on Mars 2000 sphere; planetocentric latitude
products.longitude_convention: as used: east-positive; native CRS central meridian 0, domain -180..180
products.time_coverage: Not stated in the file; built from CTX stereo images acquired before the 2020 product release (Fergason et al. 2020).
processing_steps: sha256 checked against config/sources.json
CRS checked: Mars body, metre linear units, north-up affine (no rotation)
window crop (dem_window in config/study_area.json) -> dem_crop.tif, float32, nodata preserved
slope (central differences on projected metre cells, EW scaled by cos(lat)) -> slope_deg.tif / slope.png
validity mask -> valid_coverage.tif
hillshade/elevation PNGs for display
verification_notes: Full-file read: 1596x1512 px, valid 100.0%, elevation -2710.696..-1515.54 m
Band unit tag: '' (empty; units from publisher metadata)
Supporting cross-check (rover elevations derive from orbital-map localization): DEM minus rover geoid elevation median 0.37 m over n=252 end-of-drive records
limitations: Originally created for landing-relative (Terrain Relative Navigation) navigation; not human on-foot safety data
Dataset may include a gap patched using other topography (MOLA topography per product name, as stated in handoff 04); no separate quality mask was provided, validity checked from the raster itself
20 m posts cannot resolve rocks, small scarps or soil strength

products.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX Orthorectified Image Mosaic, 6 m/pixel
products.citation: Fergason et al. 2020 (as above). Product page: https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_2020_terrain_relative_navigation_ctx_orthorectified_image_mosaic. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5066/P9GV1ND3
products.usage_terms: USGS/NASA product, public domain (U.S. Government work); credit USGS Astrogeology / NASA / JPL-Caltech / MSSS
products.coordinate_type: projected (Equirectangular, metres) on Mars 2000 sphere; planetocentric latitude
products.longitude_convention: as used: east-positive; native CRS central meridian 0, domain -180..180
products.units: 8-bit digital number (relative brightness, not calibrated reflectance)
products.time_coverage: Not stated in the file; CTX images acquired before the 2020 product release (Fergason et al. 2020).
processing_steps: sha256 checked against config/sources.json
CRS compared to DEM (identical WKT required)
crop edge required to fall on an ortho pixel edge; grid origin difference vs DEM checked against alignment tolerance
crop to the DEM bounds -> ortho_crop.tif (uint8, 6 m) and ortho.png
gradient cross-correlation against DEM slope (coarse registration check)
verification_notes: Grid origin difference vs DEM: [0.0, 0.0] m; registration check best shift {'rows': 2, 'cols': 3} cells (inconclusive, illumination-biased)
limitations: Relative brightness (8-bit DN), not calibrated reflectance
Optical-topographic alignment checked by shared grid and a coarse correlation only
products.catalog_pages_note: usgs.gov data page listed in handoff 04; an automated HEAD request on 2026-11-16 returned HTTP 403 (bot block), so it is recorded but not machine-verified. The DOI resolves to the astrogeology.usgs.gov product page.

products.name: Mars 2020 MEDA derived environmental data, sol 684 (pressure, TIRS irradiance, ancillary)
products.agency: NASA PDS Atmospheres Node / MEDA team
products.instrument: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer (MEDA): PS, TIRS

products.longitude_convention: as used: east-positive; native CRS central meridian 0, domain -180..180
processing_steps: sha256 checked against config/sources.json
hourly LMST mean/min/max

Samples kept: value column non-empty, parses as a finite float, and LMST string contains 'M' and starts with '00684M' (i.e. belongs to sol 684). No quality-flag, uncertainty or transducer filtering was applied; flag/uncertainty columns are summarised per series under 'quality' (counts over the samples used) so a reader can judge them.
verification_notes: Quality/uncertainty and flag columns summarised per series in meda.json 'quality'
limitations: Historical single-sol record; not a forecast
